Approval of Ordinances. - (a) Every ordinance enacted by the sangguniang panlalawigan, sangguniang panlungsod, or sangguniang bayan shall be presented to the provincial governor or city or municipal mayor. as the case may be. If the local chief executive concerned approves the same, he shall affix his signature on each and every page thereof: otherwise. he shall veto it and return lhe same with his objections to the Sanggunian, which may proceed to reconsider the same. The sanggunian concerned may override the veto of the local chief executive by two-thirds (2/3) vote of all its members. thereby making the ordinance or resolution effective for all legal intents and purposes.
